sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; TRACE became live on origin/data during drafting, so the same table pivoted to Ring-Zero.
Read arXiv HTML, PDF text, abstract metadata, training pipeline, benchmark table, CoT quality evaluation, ablations, dynamics, emergent behaviors, and limitations.
Extracted the four-stage zero RL pipeline, clipped importance sampling objective, ratio correction, KL and precision stabilization, sample-level loss, tiered budget training, and failure modes.
Kept the article clear that evidence is centered on mathematical RLVR, extremely expensive 1T training, LLM judge use, and emergent behavior side effects such as context anxiety.
Searched current third-party surfaces; substantive analysis is sparse because the paper is new, so the article relies mainly on original arXiv evidence and alphaXiv overview metadata.
Wrote pure Markdown with self-contained TL;DR, tables, formula explanations, Mermaid dynamics graph, evidence inventory, ablation analysis, limitations, and research extensions.
